column6: The iron golem's blade comes round.
The tree blight swings a branch.
The mummy lord pours the grave into you.
The kuo-toa whip throws a glob.
The cultist throws a ray of death.
The empyrean throws a ray of light.
The flaming skeleton points and fire goes out.
The fire giant throws its hammer.
The grimlock swings its makeshift axe.
The spirit naga throws a ray.
The cockatrice bites and the flesh sets.
The psion warps the space round you.
The violet fungus rots what it touches.
The rug of smothering wraps you.
The sahuagin priest's spectral jaws close.
The centaur warden throws a ray of sun.
The spined devil's tail spine goes in.
The invisible stalker strikes with wind.
House scope: a spell's modifiers — the spell has its own FX.
